verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack shows Mercury displaying a delivery-time estimate (e.g., 'arrives in 1 business day') for ACH or wire transfers prior to confirmation; the API/MCP/CLI docs list transfer-related endpoints (payments, recipients, treasury) but nothing about ETA display. This is a plausible mainstream banking-UX axis, so absence of evidence means 'none' rather than 'na'.
